meta.title: Skills & MCP Browser
meta.description: One floating ball opens a panel that turns your local skill library into something you can browse, search and govern: one/two-level categories plus custom groups (tree/flat views, manual groups, instant keyword grouping, AI auto-grouping with AI covers — grouping is view-only and never moves skill files), per-skill version badges with a "no version yet" fallback, per-card / per-category / library-wide enable-disable with automatic backups, and a full SKILL.md viewer. A call-ledger dashboard adds date ranges, day/week/month/year granularity, rankings, trend chart and failure details, fed automatically by the host's tools/result event. A Market tab adds an MCP market: the official MCP Registry plus a curated free catalog of 29 entries (24 npm / 5 pypi), 19 categories in flat mode with per-category counts, grid or list layout with cards cloned from the skill cards, each MCP rendered with its own real icon, one-click install that writes the profile cordis.patch.yml after an automatic backup, one-click uninstall, a free-only filter, a 24-hour disk cache and two-way instant sync with the MCP tab; the panel now has five tabs (Skills, Call Ledger, MCP, Market, Quick Start with 9 steps). An MCP panel adds live MCP config and status, tool inventory with auto Chinese summaries, per-server call statistics, enable/disable with instant UI follow, reconnect, MCP uninstall, plus standard mcpServers JSON export; a local MCP scan lists configured and installed-but-unconfigured MCP packages, and AI fix diagnoses broken MCP servers and proposes repair actions. One-click hot reload, all 130 ball skins contrast-adaptive, configurable skill root, draggable and resettable ball. The panel remembers its last scroll position and never jumps back to the top on redraw; skill cards support 3-6 per row, MCP cards 3-5 and market cards 3-6. AI grouping ships with result cache and a progress timer.
